hookups.source: https://www.bobbybrownpark.com/campground.php ('Each site is equipped with a water and electric hookup') + Campspot site amenities ('50-Amp' on 38 of 55 sites, 'Water Hook-Up' on all), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Broad River Side 25 sites (11 waterfront, 14 interior) and Savannah River Side 33 (7 waterfront, 27 interior). Of the 55 sold on Campspot, 54 take a 23-ft rig (to 55 ft); BR 4 is listed at 20 ft. Three pull-throughs. Also a primitive Pioneer camping area.

sites.source: https://www.bobbybrownpark.com/campground.php ('The Broad River Side Campground offers 25 campsites, including 11 waterfront and 14 interior sites, while the Savannah River Side Campground provides 33 campsites, with 7 waterfront and 27 interior sites') + Campspot site rvLengthMax / 'Pull-Through' amenity, Motorhome Class C permitted on every type, read 2026-10-30

facilities.source: https://www.bobbybrownpark.com/campground.php ('Both campgrounds feature comfort stations with restrooms, showers, handicap access, and washer/dryer facilities, along with a dump station in each area. WiFi is also available for all guests.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Online on Campspot or by phone at the park office, 706-283-5500; reservations open 11 months ahead and specific sites can be reserved. Holiday and special-event weekends are charged for the original arrival and departure dates. Check-in after 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.bobbybrownpark.com/campground.php ('Reservations may be made 11 months in advance by calling the Park Office at 706-283-5500. note: County-managed park on J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir.  18 designated waterfront RV sites across two campgrounds.  --AWH Formerly Bobby Brown State Outdoor Recreation Area; Elbert County now runs it. The Broad River Side and Savannah River Side campgrounds sit at the confluence and share the park's one gated entrance. --Claude
